titles.title: NIH Mentorship Modernization Act
NIH Mentorship Modernization Act

A bill to amend the Public Health Service Act to strengthen mentorship and career development support for early-career researchers receiving funding from the National Institutes of Health, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
